title: The trust of those we have supported
description: Stories of people who found guidance, clarity and support to move forward.

items.name: María Fernanda Rodríguez López
items.text: When my contract ended I had doubts about my severance and several pending payments. They reviewed my documents, explained what I was owed and filed the claim. I finally received the pending amounts, with constant support.

items.name: Diana Marcela Suárez Gómez
items.text: I live outside Colombia and needed to settle a family matter without traveling. Everything was handled virtually, they explained each stage and the process was completed correctly. I appreciate their closeness and patience.

items.name: Carlos Andrés Pérez Rojas
items.text: An agency was not responding to a situation that affected my rights. They analyzed the case and filed the tutela with the necessary evidence. The ruling was favorable and the agency complied. Every step was explained simply.

items.name: Laura Camila Cárdenas Torres
items.text: I was still reported even though I had paid the debt. They reviewed the dates, communications and due process, and filed the requests. The report was corrected and I regained peace of mind about my credit history.

items.name: Jorge Enrique Martínez Ruiz
items.text: I had old traffic fines and didn't know if they could still be collected. They reviewed each file and the notices, and filed the requests with the transit authority. The obligations that didn't meet legal requirements were corrected.

items.name: Andrés Felipe Torres Vega
items.text: After an accident I didn't know which documents to gather or how to file a claim. They organized the medical records and supported me through the request. The claim was accepted and I received the compensation.

items.name: Sofía Valentina Gómez León
items.text: For months I asked an agency for information without a complete answer. They prepared a clear, well-supported petition, and the agency delivered the information I needed to move forward with my case.

items.name: Camilo Alejandro Álvarez Díaz
items.text: I didn't know how to request recognition and reparation of my rights. They listened to my story respectfully, reviewed my documents and helped me file the requests. The process moved forward and I received an answer.
